limitations: Both runs use the same ngspice42 engine and PDK models with different linear solvers(Sparse/KLU), not two independent circuit simulators.

The independent audit reconstructs memory from measured rising-edge writes, separately checks stimulus order/data, and checks every saved sample in17.5--19.5ns windows against the reconstructed memory. It does not reuse either simulation runner measurement summary as an oracle.

The complete107303row waveforms from both runs, all raw simulator logs and all256per-cycle measurements are preserved losslessly. Six mutations reject wrong output/address, nonfinite/unknown data, reversed time and truncated simulation.
KLU originally declared14400seconds; an explicit preserved runtime-budget extension allowed completion at16415.916seconds. No waveform is represented as completing within the original deadline.
The independently generated512x64byte bank still needs its own transistor characterization,Liberty and integration. Full-chip LVS on the original SRAMs and final extracted timing remain open.
